title: Final progress updates are discarded when all futures finish
reasoning: Future completion does not mean the progress queue has been consumed. When the last worker finishes, the loop exits even if terminal updates remain queued. The display can consequently retain running states and omit final costs and solved-checkpoint counts. Workers that finish before the first loop condition can have all their updates discarded.
reproduction: Have a fake executor enqueue progress updates and return already-completed futures. Call _run_problems and observe that the queue remains populated and problem states remain pending.
recommendation: After all producers finish, drain remaining progress messages through the same update handler and refresh the display before returning.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The executor test returns already-completed futures but enqueues no progress messages and asserts only results and executor configuration.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand the executor scenario to cover queued updates before and during future completion, asserting that every problem's final state, usage, and evaluation counts are applied.
